summary: Instinct Bio Technical Company Holdings Inc., a Tokyo-based foreign private issuer formerly named Relativity Holdings, furnished a Form 6-K on October 16, 2026, carrying interim results for subsidiary Instinct Bio Technical Company Inc. for the six months ended May 31, 2026. Exhibits include unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements, MD&A and a press release. Reported total assets were $4.08 million against $1.99 million liabilities, with equity of $2.09 million. No transaction, stake, price or board recommendation appears. This is a routine earnings filing, not a special situation; watch for going-concern and cash-position disclosures given $25,565 cash.
